items.note: B1 and B1.2-B1.3 state the lemma correctly (y_S gets y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch, three stages give (X,Y) to (-Y,X) with scratch restored), and B1.1/B1.3 follow the proof (net map JV+RG, then the stage composition). But the plan never defines the copy, gather, scatter and side-injection gates or the neighbour rules, and it never gives the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2. So the coefficient check in B1.2 (lines 752-759) cannot be reconstructed, and the neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783) are missing.

Follows the paper step by step: the invariant that the stored array equals D_v applied to the logical array, the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator with its sign epsilon_w on every role, auxiliary roles included.

The plan states the nested nondegenerate labels, the single decreasing edge type (centre 3 to 4, loss h), L=Ich, the total Wm-2N+2L and L_b/N=100/539, and derives the telescoping. It omits L_c/N=101/539 and the lemma's clause that every binary residual has an orthonormal basis. Its method promises the gate-label table (eq:motif-labels, 975-988) and the residual table (1021-1043) but never gives them, and the side-wire nesting P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^perp appears only as a motivation.

Follows the proof: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N source exceptions with first edge matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m with frames Phi_M. The assignment of P_U to gates and sinks, and of 0 to the other sources, is only implicit.

Follows the proof: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving the kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse, the count s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c, the exceptional X_a to Y_a pair (C^{-1} on 27 coordinates, fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z), and negating the X outputs to get C^{⊗m} on every role and on k columns.

The plan has s<Wm for both networks, eta>20·2^{-50}, m<2^20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta), and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. It never gives the exact deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 on which B7.1 rests, and for the complex network it gives no loss ratio (101/539): B6.3 just asserts 2N-2L_c>0.

A1 states the elementary stream operations correctly. A2 drops the hypotheses of lem:ordered-affine-streams (q prime, rational denominators prime to q, controls with offsets of O(b) digits). A's method is a one-line gesture at splitting and merging, and its sub-steps restate the lemmas rather than derive them. The split at Q-a for the controlled shift and the c-piece split for multiplication by a unit (574-614) are absent.

Both lemmas are stated correctly, and the shear derivation (triangular transforms in descending order, conjugating Pi by E_1 and E_2, one interchange per pivot) matches 1425-1446. But the elimination proof of A=E_1 Pi E_2 (topmost row, rightmost pivot, 1375-1391) is absent, apart from the A=0 case. The choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators (1413-1423) is also not mentioned.

Follows the paper's proof in order: the k=0 base case, the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, H gets H+D on every row by the endpoint identity, the three-step interchange, s calls, F_k ≤ (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum giving O(e^tau), and the depth-first parking schedule.

Follows the proof: small widths done digit by digit, high digits used as a row field with R=q^{2rho} ≥ W^k, zero-row padding to R'<2R, a base-m split of e-rho, the geometric cost sum and binary padding to [q^e]. The unequal-width remark (1740-1762) is not covered.

All the key identities are present and correct: the P_M conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} with P_M a fixed number of row additions, the inverse child (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f} C^{⊗f} Z^{⊗f}, exactly s_c children on the f=e/m axes of a slot, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The slot and column bookkeeping is compressed into D3.

The plan gives only the regime form O(V(L^tau+1)), not the explicit bound with the M A^3 and delta_bad terms. The derivation has the eight-step parity gadget, the guard and bad-set bound, and the repair by sorting. It lacks the tape realisation of each rotation: a chunk swap to put the target after its controls (the source of the L^tau term), then a controlled shift and the swap undone (2117-2155). It also lacks the separate XOR at the top position j_{f-1} (2187-2193).

The recurrence F(e) ≤ (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1), the leaves F(e)=O(e), the V/W children and the lambda' range are stated. But lambda (with tau(1+c/beta)<lambda) is never defined, and the row index made of the first q_0 chunks is not described. Unrolling is just asserted in D8: the bound K ≤ e^{c/beta}, the geometric internal sum and the leaf bound e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)} (2413-2441) are absent.

The plan states the layer's output Q_p(Hz), its O(Vd^{lambda'}) cost, error below √2·2^{-p}, and guard width ⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉=o(p). The guard-width derivation itself is absent: the depth recurrence A(e) ≤ sA(e/m)+E and the constants E, B, nu, C_1 (2457-2586). D11 only quotes its conclusion, and the check that packed calls cost the same uniformly (2696-2735) is not reproduced.

Follows the paper's route. Character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, the DIF step, the bit-reversed slots B_t, and the reverse procedure giving F_t^+B_t^{-1} are all there. So are grouping a round into H followed by J_E, the prefix moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), and error √2·ℓ·2^{-p}. The L-conjugation that identifies LBF^- is only implicit, through the LB order in F2.1.

Follows the proof: evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the 4pr-bit magnitudes, four products with the established multiplier, |h_j| < B_0/2 giving centred residues, h-hat_j=h_j, and the cost dominated by the four products.
Retained LB order, the normalisation F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), and the error M(3delta+eta) all match the proof. F2.4's justification of the third delta is loose (see errors).

The identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, the N=CTD Neumann inversion, the normalisations and the tensor form with its costs are correct. But P_s and P_t ((P_su)_j=u_{tj}, (P_tv)_k=v_{-sk}) are never defined. The numerical algorithms for A~ and B~_0 are absent: the quoted S', J', D' with error bounds 16p, 3p^2/4 and 4, the ordered selection C, and the Neumann iteration (3644-3792).

Follows the proof: the chirp coefficient check with Q reading frequency -s_i j_i, the dilation identity F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ from t_i being a unit mod s_i, R F_s^+ R = F_s^+, and the two normalisations giving (u*v)/S^2.

The prime-length argument (4103-4193) is reproduced faithfully. But H1.1 omits delta=1/16 and beta, and alpha=⌈(12d^2b)^{1/4}⌉ and the bound gamma=o(b) (gamma ≤ b/4) are never given. The check that the fixed exponents satisfy the layer and margin conditions (4018-4036), and the comparison constants (4073-4088), appear only as a phrase in H1's method.

Follows the paper: the isomorphism from the order-S image of x, the triangular mixed-radix coordinates b_i, rotations that preserve the valid set, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and O(d^2) axis swaps costing O(Tp d^2(1+ℓ^tau)).

The exact twist x_d to zeta·y, its isomorphism and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j are correct. The formula M_C(f,g)=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T is never stated. The computed convolution (twist arrays, Q_p after each phase product, twist errors below 4·2^{-p}, 4374-4402) is reduced to the cost line H3.4.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, times 2^gamma, with exact counterpart RF_s and the conjugate opposite) and all six algorithm steps match the paper, including the two occurrences of S that undo (u*v)/S^2.

E_ring<5TL, E_s=9·2^gamma·TL, E_w<28·2^gamma·T^2·L, the final error below 1/2, rounding and the carry bound are all stated correctly. But the condition gamma ≤ b/4 behind 2^{-b+gamma} ≤ 2^{-3b/4} is missing. The chirp error 8TL, the complex-convolution error 6TL and the source error 2^gamma(2dp^2+8TL) (4598-4654), from which E_s comes, are not derived.

Reproduces the cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^{-181}=2kappa from the chunk exchanges, the o(Tp) setup and exceptional-sort costs, and absorbing powers of log p to reach O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}).

No step discusses the n log n conjecture, the eventual lower bound T_A(n) ≥ c_A n lg n, or why a liminf of zero refutes it. Only R's reliance on 'nlogn-history' and its Theta(n log n) motivation point that way, so the conservative verdict is absent.

errors.says: Every edge change is a product of two-point kernels C=aI+bX.
errors.paper: Each edge's phase-frame difference is a product of one translation kernel aI+bX_v, or its inverse, per vector of an orthonormal residual basis, where X_v is translation by v. These kernels are directional, not the fixed coordinate kernel C (B6.2 states this correctly).

errors.says: Labels are built from 'tensor cubes' of indicator vectors of three-element subsets.
errors.paper: The basic vectors are u_a=t_{a_1}⊗t_{a_2}⊗t_{a_3}, threefold tensor products of three generally different triple indicators, not cubes t⊗t⊗t.

errors.says: The two forward errors give 2delta, truncation adds eta, and the opposite transform is a contraction, so the error is below M(3delta+eta).
errors.paper: The third delta is the opposite procedure's own approximation error. Contraction alone would give 2delta+eta, and the paper adds the opposite output's error to reach 3delta+eta.

errors.says: The linewise implementations of A and B_0 each have error below dp^2 (quoting 'Both A and B_0 are contractions.').
errors.paper: The quoted sentence states contraction, not the error bound. The dp^2 error bound is in the next sentence (3818-3820) and is proved at 3857-3861.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. It goes from the scalar exchange network, frames, labels and the rank budget (B) to the interchange recursion (C) and the phase-frame butterfly layer (D). From there it runs through synthetic transforms and convolution (X), resampling and the chirp (Y), and parameters, recovery and cost (Z), ending in O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out where it states results without their machinery: the gate definitions and coefficient check of the exchange network, the label and residual tables, the factorisation proof and the choice of q, the swap-and-rotate realisation in the packed addition, the guard-width depth recurrence, the Gaussian numerical maps, and the twist and chirp error accounting.

steps.note: B1 and B1.3 give the fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) in three stages with every scratch wire restored, and B3 fixes the triples of [100] (h=100). The formulas N=binom(100,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never written: N and the m-dimensional space are used without definition.
A common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the endpoint frames alone fix each route, so intermediate frames are free to make edges cheap.

Each gate gets a nondegenerate subspace of F^{⊗3}, neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are central 3 to 4, each losing P⊗F of dimension h.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels. The N source edges are the only exception: the matrix there is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change is zero.
The absolute dimension changes sum to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the rank total is s=Wm-N+2L once the N source ranks are added.
L_b/N=100/539<1/2, so N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_bm, which is the bit chain the saving runs on. The complex ratio 101/539 is missing: B6.3 only asserts 2N-2L_c>0.
M_{sink(rho(w))}-M_{source(w)}=I_m on every role, quoting P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m. With frames Phi_M this gives H gets H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, the triangular factors cost O(V), each pivot is one interchange, so an edge of rank a makes a recursive interchanges and a node makes exactly s calls.
Children have volume V/W, F_k ≤ (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20·2^{-50} and m<2^20, which gives F_k=O(e^tau). The exact eta values are not displayed.

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed in order (B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, then C1-C3 and B7): the restoring exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-N+2L, the strict deficit N-2L>0, the endpoint identity giving H gets H+D, one interchange per rank unit, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weak points are minor: N and m are never defined as binom(100,3)^3 and 100^3, the complex loss ratio is missing, and the exact deficits eta are asserted rather than displayed.
